_comment: Single source of truth for which server/ files are CODE (ship in the APK's stageServer task AND in a hot-update zip from tools/build_hostapp_update.py). Keeping one list keyed off this file, instead of a hardcoded list in build.gradle, is what stopped `battle_effects`/`battle_data` from silently going stale here after the Phase 0 engine-package split -- see memory sevensins-hostapp-updater. `data_files` are single files copied verbatim (save_editor_ui.html is the editor's whole UI); without it the editor serves a 500 and the page is blank.
